# Paths whose changes alone skip the build and test jobs of ci.yml and
# windows.yml (job version, step "Documentation-only change?"): files no
# build, test or packaging step reads. Shell glob patterns, one per line,
# matched against the whole path. A doc that a test reads (README.md,
# CHANGELOG.md, doc/SHORTLIST.md, doc/SPECIES-DETECTOR.md, ...) is NOT here.

doc/MANUAL.md
doc/GUI-REVIEW-*.md
